problem_text: Every time it rains, water collects near the school and children cannot cross the road.
Recurrent flooding requiring sensor-based waterlogging warning and topographical drainage design.
Drinking water pipeline leak causing muddy contaminated water to flow from taps in Ward 4.
Groundwater contamination with high fluoride levels requiring novel low-cost arsenic filter and telemetry.
Deep crater pothole outside primary school entrance causing accidents for two-wheelers.
Garbage dump lying uncollected for two weeks near vegetable market creating foul stench and disease risk.
Transformer spark and hanging wire exposed near street corner posing electrocution hazard.
Dengue cases spreading in village due to stagnant water, Primary Health Centre has no doctor available.
Irrigation canal breached flooding paddy fields, farmers unable to stop water loss.
Dark street with broken streetlights leading to multiple theft incidents at night.
